name: Daily Work Connectors
description: Workflow for adding or using productivity connectors such as GitHub, GitLab, Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Jira, Linear, Notion, Drive, and CRM systems.

chain.step: Identify the productivity system, user workflow, account boundary, auth method, and intended actions.
Fetch current official API or connector docs when wiring details are not already known.
Design least-privilege scopes, approval gates, data retention, and audit logging before writes.
Catalog stable public endpoints or docs for future reuse when appropriate.
Ask for user confirmation before sending messages, changing calendars, creating tickets, or modifying repos.
